prompt: Changing a card priority on the board: do all 420 cards re-render?

truth.summary: BoardCard is wrapped in memo and receives the issue entity and a stable onOpen callback; only the changed card's entity changes.

flaggedWhen: Genie reports more than one BoardCard updating after one priority change.

genieEvidence.notes: react_component_cohort reports exactly one updated BoardCard out of 420.
